full_prompt_en: This square classical oil-style portrait painting shows a seated young woman in a broad pale hat and a pale sage-cream dress against a softly patterned background. Behind her, the light cream wall carries barely visible floral motifs in muted beige and pink, most noticeable near the left edge. She sits near the centre, turned slightly toward the viewer, with her face angled forward and dark eyes meeting the gaze. Her dark curly hair spreads beneath the hat brim and frames her cheeks. The hat has a wide, gently curved brim in warm ivory, with a darker green fabric accent gathered at the crown. Her dress has a high neckline, long fitted sleeves and a pale bodice, with fine folds running down toward a full skirt that fills the lower part of the image. A deep green sash wraps her waist and trails behind her left side. One hand rests low beside the skirt, while the other is partly obscured by the folds and crop. The softly lustrous pale fabric is decorated with delicate lace-like texture and faint embroidered marks along the collar, cuffs and bodice. At the bottom-left corner, a small cluster of reddish flowers and leaves sits beside the skirt; other background details remain soft and indistinct. The light is broad and even, giving a gentle glow to the hat, face and fabric without sharp shadows. Warm reflected light adds a subtle golden tone to the pale surfaces, while dark hair and the green sash provide contrast. The overall composition is calm and balanced, with the wide hat and pale dress forming a central light shape against the faint patterned ground and muted floral accents.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形古典油画式肖像描绘一位坐着的年轻女性，她戴着宽阔浅色帽子，身穿浅鼠尾草绿与奶油色衣裙，身后是柔和纹样背景。身后的浅奶油色墙面带有几乎看不清的花卉纹样，颜色为低饱和米色和粉色，左侧边缘附近较明显。她靠近画面中央，身体略转向观者，脸朝前，深色眼睛迎向视线。深色卷发从帽檐下散开，围住双颊。帽檐宽阔而微微弯曲，呈暖象牙色，帽冠处聚着一块较深的绿色布饰。她的连衣裙领口较高、长袖贴身，浅色衣身上有纤细褶皱向下延展，宽裙摆占据画面下部。深绿色腰带环绕腰间，并在她左侧向后垂落。一只手低低放在裙子旁，另一只手部分被衣褶和取景边界遮住。带柔和光泽的浅色布料上有精细的蕾丝般肌理，领口、袖口和胸衣处还能看到淡淡的刺绣痕迹。左下角的裙边旁有一小簇红色花朵和叶片，其余背景细节都比较柔和模糊。光线宽阔均匀，让帽子、面部和布料显出柔和亮度，没有锐利投影。暖色反光为浅色表面添上轻微金色调，深发与绿腰带则形成对比。整体构图安静平衡，以宽帽檐和浅色衣裙构成中央亮形，衬托浅淡纹样底面与低调花饰。
style_prompt_en: Classical oil-style painting combines smooth tonal modelling with delicate surface detail and softened edges. Pale sage, cream and warm ivory form broad luminous areas, while deep green, charcoal and muted rose provide restrained accents. Fine linear marks and faint ornamental textures sit within larger, calm colour masses, creating detail without disrupting the open space. Light is broad and diffused, so transitions remain gradual and shadows stay soft. The arrangement is centred and balanced, with a few darker accents anchoring the light field. The overall effect is quiet, refined and gently luminous.
style_prompt_zh: 古典油画式处理将平滑调性塑形、细致表面纹理与柔化边缘结合起来。浅鼠尾草绿、奶油色和暖象牙色形成宽阔明亮区域，深绿、炭灰与低饱和玫瑰色提供克制点缀。细线和淡淡装饰肌理置于较大的平静色块之中，带来细节而不破坏留白。光线宽阔漫射，色调过渡渐进，阴影柔和。构图居中而平衡，少量深色点稳住明亮底面。整体效果安静、雅致并带有柔和光感。
theme_en: A woman in a broad pale hat and a pale sage-cream dress sits against a light floral background, with dark hair and a green sash.
theme_zh: 一位深发女性戴宽檐浅色帽，穿浅鼠尾草绿与奶油色衣裙、系绿色腰带，坐在浅淡花纹背景前。
name: 雅致花纹肖像油画
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
